prompt:
You forward messages in a neighborhood chat group. Rewrite the message below the way this person would forward it.
Person: Emilio, who is fairly open to believing neighborhood rumors. Emilio thinks the municipal pool has been badly maintained for years.
Change to make: ADD A DETAIL: add one specific detail (a number, a place, a date, a name of a made-up neighbor) that was not in the message.
Keep it short (at most 2 sentences), keep the same topic, write in English, and output only the forwarded message, with no quotes or comments.

Message: "I heard a rumor that the municipal pool might stay closed this summer due to some potential issues with the water test, though I’m not sure if it’s true since the staff usually handle things so well."
text: I’m not surprised at all, especially since Mrs. Higgins mentioned the filtration system failed back on May 12th. It sounds like the pool will finally be closed all summer after years of poor maintenance.
